system.description:
You believe you must consume the organs and blood-bearing tissue of your victims, the liver, kidneys, heart and other pieces, in order to sustain yourself. You must purchase the Eat Food Merit to devour them, and you can only absorb Blood Traits by eating these organs; blood drunk from any other source is vomited back up.

This hunger necessitates the deaths of your prey, creating problems for both the Masquerade and your Morality.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
